Diameter at most two restricts the range to 0,1,2. Opposite extreme level sets form a missing-edge biclique; H being K_{2,2}-free forces one extreme set singleton. Every missing-star assignment is feasible and has numerator F_n(k)=n(k+1)-(k-1)^2; binary assignments yield B_n. Its concave quadratic envelope, the 2/n bound and the complement-cycle threshold follow by exact arithmetic. Independent exhaustive anchored enumeration for G=C5 obtained numerator 14 and 51 admissible anchored integral potentials. This finite test corroborates but does not prove the all-graph statement.
